parsed.reason: The reply does two things well: it states the registration window as Hale's own verified fact (correct), confirms it is already watching and will text before (correct, watching is true), and hands over the webFind (Tiny Tumblers) with proper attribution to the venue's own program page (correct per the webFind rule). However, it ends with "want me to confirm details?" — this is a dangling question that turns the webFind into a hedged offer rather than just handing it over cleanly. The webFind rule says Hale is REQUIRED to hand it over with attribution, and naming whose page it came from is the honesty the source demands — the reply does that, but then adds a question that implies Hale is holding back or needs to do more checking before the parent can act on it. That question is unnecessary and slightly undermines the clean delivery. It also says "no price listed yet" which is appropriate (honest attribution). The reply is otherwise tight: no greeting, no sign-off, no app referral, no invented URL, correct registration facts, correct watching claim. The trailing question is a small but real shape problem — it invites chatter and implies the webFind is somehow conditional, when the rule says to hand it over fully. This is a minor blemish, not a serious failure, so a 4 is appropriate.
